title: FIT TO RUN 2026 Leg 3 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: FIT TO RUN Leg 3 Clark Review: Field, Times and Weather
meta_description: FIT TO RUN Leg 3 review from the 21 December 2025 race at Clark Parade Grounds: 3,153 timed finishers, a 5:34 median marathon, and 24°C, 83% humidity before dawn.
dek: What the 21 December 2025 Leg 3 at Clark Parade Grounds was like, from the official results and the airport weather: how big and how fast the field was, and what the air felt like before dawn.
verdict: Enter if you want a relaxed, unpretentious Clark race where finishing is the point. The 2025 Leg 3 timed 3,153 finishers across the marathon, half and 10 km, up by more than half on 2024, and most of them were not racing the clock: half the marathon field finished after 5 hours 34, and the median 10 km took almost an hour and a half. December gave it mild air, 24°C before dawn, but humidity sat above 80% until 8am and it reached 28°C by 10am, so the back of the marathon field finished in real heat. The front is thin: a marathon under 3 hours 40 made the top ten.

sections.heading: Where It Runs
paragraphs: Leg 3 of SMOKE10 Events' FIT TO RUN series starts and finishes at the CDC Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga. The 2025 race on Sunday 21 December offered a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The 2024 Leg 3 used the same venue on Sunday 10 November 2024 with the same four distances [2], and the 2026 race returns there on Sunday 8 November 2026 [3].

sections.heading: The Weather: Cool for Luzon, Still Humid
paragraphs: Clark International Airport, inside the same freeport, recorded 23°C and 94% humidity at midnight on race day, then 24°C with a dew point of 21°C and 83% to 89% humidity from 2am to 7am, with almost no wind [4]. It warmed quickly after sunrise: 26°C at 8am, 27°C at 9am, 28°C at 10am and 30°C at 11am [4].

That is about as kind as Central Luzon gets, but the median marathoner was still out for five and a half hours, and the slowest 10% took more than 6 hours 49 [1]. Those runners finished at 28°C to 30°C in full sun. The November date in 2024 was slightly warmer before dawn, 25°C and 83% humidity, and reached 30°C by 10am [5]; the 2026 race returns to an early November date [3].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The 2025 race timed 411 marathon, 912 half-marathon and 1,830 10 km finishers, against 214, 604 and 1,174 in 2024: the marathon field almost doubled and the shorter races grew by about half [1][2].

Most of the field runs to finish. Half the marathoners took longer than 5:33:48, only 6.4% broke 4 hours and 31.2% broke 5 [1]. In the half marathon the median was 2:42:41, about seven minutes faster than in 2024, and 35.2% finished inside 2:30; in the 10 km the median was 1:29:19, and only 6.1% ran under an hour [1][2]. The marathon median barely moved from 2024, when it was 5:30:40 [2].

The front is within reach of a good club runner. The 2025 marathon top ten ran from 2:51:27 to 3:38:28, the half-marathon top ten from 1:19:28 to 1:37:06 and the 10 km top ten from 36:41 to 43:54 [1]. The fastest woman ran the marathon in 3:46:11, and 4:43:56 was tenth among women [1]. Women made up 16.8% of marathon finishers, 27.5% of the half and 44.9% of the 10 km [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a low-key Clark race with a big, mostly recreational field, where a sub-4 marathon puts you in the top 7% and a 3:40 might put you in the top ten. The 10 km, with a median near an hour and a half, suits walkers and first-timers.

Think twice if you want a fast, deep race: the front of the field is thin, and runners out past 5 hours will finish in midday heat. The 2026 Leg 3 is on Sunday 8 November 2026 at the same parade grounds [3].
This review draws on the official results of the 2024 and 2025 Leg 3 races and on Clark airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to be to place at FIT TO RUN Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Not very fast. At the 21 December 2025 race, tenth place in the marathon was 3:38:28 and in the half marathon 1:37:06, while the 10 km top ten ran from 36:41 to 43:54. The fastest woman ran the marathon in 3:46:11. Half the marathon field finished after 5:33:48, so a sub-4 marathon put a runner in the top 7%.

faqs.question: How hot is FIT TO RUN Leg 3 at Clark?
faqs.answer: Mild before dawn, hot by mid-morning. On 21 December 2025 Clark airport recorded 24°C, a dew point of 21°C and 83% to 89% humidity from 2am to 7am, with almost no wind. It reached 26°C at 8am, 28°C at 10am and 30°C at 11am. The 2026 race is earlier in the year, on 8 November, when the 2024 race saw 25°C before dawn.

faqs.question: How many people run FIT TO RUN Leg 3?
faqs.answer: Around 3,000 timed finishers in 2025. The 21 December 2025 race timed 411 marathon, 912 half-marathon and 1,830 10 km finishers, up from 214, 604 and 1,174 at the 2024 Leg 3. Women made up 16.8% of marathon finishers and 44.9% of the 10 km. A 5 km also runs but is not counted here.

editorial_notes: Reinstated 2026-11-06: official results for the 2024 and 2025 Leg 3 races (both at CDC Clark Parade Grounds) are now on file, so the series has a documented past edition. Written about the 2025 Leg 3 (21 December 2025), with year-over-year comparison to 2024 (10 November 2024). Finisher counts, medians, percentiles and milestone shares use chip times, excluding results whose chip time is more than 20 minutes faster than the official gun time (7 marathon, 21 half and 32 10 km rows in 2025, e.g. a 2:06:52 marathon chip time against a 5:36:56 gun time, and a 1:03:02 half against 1:43:41; these are timing errors). Top-ten bands are the official gun-time rankings. Start times, cut-offs, aid stations and the route were not found, so those sections are omitted. Weather is from Clark airport METAR observations. The 2026 Leg 3 page still showed 8 November 2026 at the same venue on 6 November 2026. Runners are not named. No rating.
